title: From High Bar to Uneven Bars: The Impact of Information Granularity in Quality Certification
authors: Xiang Hui; Zekun Liu; Weiqing Zhang
eligible_reason: Field experiment on eBay introducing a new certification tier (eGD) at one start date: Table 3 regresses seller-month outcomes on optin*post with seller FE and year and month FE (post = after the experiment starts, common to all sellers). Single adoption date; Tables 4-5 are post-period cross-sectional comparisons; Table 6 matched-listing regressions; Table 7 market-level OLS.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm). code_table3.R: felm(y ~ optin*post | slr_id + yr + mn | 0 | slr_id), full sample and by etrs_pre. Data are simulated.
data_files_note: Readme: 'All data sets provided in this sample are simulated and are only meant to demonstrate the content and structure of the data sets. These data sets should not be used for any replication.' eBay data confidential.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not staggered (single experiment start); simulated data.
